aim:
The contact section: enquiry details (email, phone, location, response-time badge) beside a
validated enquiry form that DELIVERS. 2 active placements / 2 sites at authoring time.
contract: - Root `section.contact-block-section[data-component="contact-block"]`.
- `.cb-heading` is unconditional -> must carry text.
- `form.cb-form` present.
- **The form must name a destination.** `form.cb-form[action]:not([action=""])` — any
scheme, deliberately, so this stays true when the component is pointed at a real receipt
endpoint instead of a mailto. This is the check whose ABSENCE let `bugs_open/228` ship,
and it catches BOTH states that bug passed through: no `action` attribute at all (the
original defect) and `action=""` (the intermediate state on v1.0.1270, before the
class fix was live). The value itself is not asserted — it is derived per site from
`sites.email` by `sanitiseFormAction`, so pinning it here would make the contract
site-specific and would duplicate a rule that lives in one place.
- **The interactive half.** `/tools/assets/contact-block.js` binds submit, calls
`preventDefault()`, validates, then routes on the action's SCHEME: `http(s)` -> POST and
report what the server said; `mailto:` -> build the URL with explicit `subject=`/`body=`
and hand off, saying "opening your email app", never "sent"; anything else -> refuse and
say the form has no destination. The fence clicks submit on an EMPTY form and asserts
`#cb-status.cb-error` carries text.
> **SUPERSEDED 2026-08-09 — this PLAN's previous version said the fence "deliberately does
> NOT assert the success message", because asserting it would have made this contract vouch
> for a claim that was false to the visitor (`bugs_open/228`). That reason has gone: the
> component now delivers, and the destination check above is the assertion that reason was
> standing in for. The success STRING is still not asserted directly — it is reachable only
> from a destination that accepted the message, and pinning the wording would fence the copy
> rather than the behaviour.
proof_note: Single-instance placement; 22 assets probed, all 200; the served page carries the site's own mailto, supplied by the class fix (85390ee33, live v1.0.1274) with NO hand-seeded content_data key.
mutants: 10/10 caught, every check watched red, baseline green
notes: **Delivery is end-to-end verified, not inferred.** Both served pages were driven as a
visitor in a real browser — fill, submit, and assert the `mailto:` the browser is actually
sent to. It carries the name, message and reply address, is addressed to that site's own
`sites.email` inbox, and the visitor's text is preserved (we cannot know they pressed send).
**The remaining honest limit**, stated so a reader does not over-read this contract: a
`mailto:` is a handoff to the visitor's mail client, not an awaitable request. The `http(s)`
branch is implemented and tested for the day a receipt endpoint exists; see `bugs_open/228`
for what that would take. Owning lane for the bug: `bugfix_228_contact_block_transport`.
